Both render the dues table and following paragraph across the break equally.

left_defects.translation: Title 4, Principal, on the state of the clergy (merged into citation)

why: Left drops noualia at the crossing clause and garbles the fourth-principal heading into a citation; right only leaves citation fragments untranslated.
Both render the crossing litany fully and faithfully.
